# tenferro v0.8.0

v0.8.0 replaces backend sessions with caller-owned execution engines, moves the
CPU backend onto the published tcontract, cpueinsum and tlinalg providers with
`threadteam` as the one placement token, replaces the CubeCL CUDA backend with
a kernel-catalogue engine (and drops the WebGPU/Metal lane), and adds
activation, softmax and normalization operations on every surface. This is a
breaking release: most programs need the migration steps below. The
[API migration guide](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/blob/main/docs/getting-started/api-migration.md)
has the full old-to-new table.

## Migration

### Dependencies and features

- Update `tenferro-*` dependency requirements from `0.7` to `0.8` together.
- The CPU stack now resolves from crates.io releases with caret requirements
  (no git pins). Downstream crates that use these crates directly must move to
  the same versions, because `tenferro_cpu::faer` re-exports t4a-faer and
  `threadteam::Exec` / `threadteam::Pool` appear in the public API. The `faer`
  dependency key now names the tensor4all fork `t4a-faer` instead of upstream
  `faer`: depend on `t4a-faer` 0.27 or use the `tenferro_cpu::faer` re-export,
  since upstream `faer` types no longer match.

  | crate | v0.7.1 | v0.8.0 |
  |---|---|---|
  | `faer` key | upstream faer 0.24 | t4a-faer 0.27 |
  | threadteam | (none) | 0.2 |
  | strided-basic, -perm, -kernel, -fused | 0.4 | 0.9 |
  | strided-nn | (none) | 0.9 |
  | strided-view, strided-traits | 0.4 | 0.7 |
  | tcontract-exec | (none) | 0.9 |
  | cpueinsum, cpueinsum-blas | (none) | 0.9 |
  | tlinalg / tlinalg-blas | (none) | 0.8 / 0.5 |

  threadteam 0.2 caches a default `Pool` when it is dropped and hands it to the
  next pool of the same width.
  ([#2138](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2138), [#2276](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2276), [#2289](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2289), [#2328](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2328))
- CPU provider features are renamed: `cpu-faer` is now `native` (the default)
  and `cpu-blas` is now `blas`, in every crate that forwards them. The two are
  mutually exclusive, so a BLAS build needs `default-features = false`.
  ([#2026](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2026))
- The `webgpu` feature, the WebGPU/Metal backend and the `cubecl-interop`
  feature are removed. CUDA (`cuda` feature) is the only GPU backend. It is
  built on `t4a-cuda-runtime` 0.1 and `t4a-cuda-kernels` 0.1 from crates.io
  instead of CubeCL.
  ([#2291](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2291), [#2330](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2330))

### Execution model

- Backend sessions are replaced by engines the caller owns and borrows with
  `&mut`. Build one with `CpuEngine::new(pool)`, `CpuEngine::serial()` or
  `CudaEngine::open(ordinal)`; these replace `CpuBackend` and `CudaBackend`,
  `with_backend_session`, held sessions and their guards.
  ([#1944](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1944), [#1947](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1947), [#2209](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2209))
- Operations, `ctx.with_eager_session(&mut engine, |s| ...)`, `backward`,
  `backward_with`, `grad`, `vjp`, `jvp` and `to_tensor` take the engine
  explicitly. The `with_eager_session` callback may return any error type
  that implements `From<tenferro_ad::Error>`. ([#2014](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2014), [#2209](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2209))
- Compiled graphs run through
  `runtime.prepare(&program, &reads, &[engine.target()])` and
  `runtime.run(&mut [&mut engine], &prepared, &reads)`; `run_compiled`,
  `prepare_compiled` and `run_prepared` are removed. Convert each output with
  `output.into_tensor(&mut engine)`. ([#2209](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2209))
- CPU threads come from a `threadteam::Pool` you build and hand to the engine:
  `CpuEngine::new(tenferro_cpu::Pool::builder().threads(n).build()?)` replaces
  `CpuBackend::with_threads(n)`, and the placement selectors (`for_placement`,
  `for_domain`) are removed.
  `tenferro-cpu` re-exports `threadteam`, `Pool` and `PoolBuilder`. tenferro no
  longer creates pools, resolves CPU sets or NUMA placement, or reads
  `RAYON_NUM_THREADS` for engine pools. A multi-thread engine runs its parallel
  work on a `threadteam` team; `CpuEngine::has_team()` reports whether it holds
  one. ([#2276](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2276), [#2289](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2289), [#2290](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2290))
- Direct faer calls inside tenferro's parallel region use `Par::Team` on a team
  token and `Par::Seq` otherwise, through the re-exported
  `tenferro_cpu::faer`. ([#2290](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2290), [#2318](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2318))

### Tensor and AD surface

- `HostTensor<T>` and `HostTensorView<'a, T>` are removed. Use
  `TypedTensor<T, DynRank, Host>` and `TypedTensorView<'a, T, DynRank, Host>`.
  `tenferro_tensor::core` re-exports metadata only; import tensor types from the
  `tenferro_tensor` root. ([#1947](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1947))
- `TypedTensorView::try_slice`, `try_slice_axis` and `try_reshape` (and the
  mutable forms) are now `slice_view`, `slice_axis_view` and `reshape_view`.
  ([#1947](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1947))
- The eager einsum traits that entered a session themselves
  (`EagerEinsumExt`, `EagerTensorEinsumExt`) are replaced by
  `EagerSessionEinsumExt` on a borrowed eager session. ([#1947](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1947))
- Concrete `reduce_sum` and eager/traced `reduce_sum_squares` take
  `Option<&[usize]>`; `None` reduces every axis. ([#2014](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2014))
- `GraphCompiler::compile_with_input_specs` rejects a declared placeholder that
  the output does not use. Before, a tensor passed for it could be bound to a
  different input. Drop the unused binding. ([#2014](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2014))

### Numerical behavior

- `full_piv_lu` is one rank-revealing kernel (faer complete pivoting) in both
  the `native` and `blas` builds. Singular input now factorizes, with the rank
  visible in `U`, instead of returning an error. `full_piv_lu_solve` rejects a
  pivot at or below `eps * max|pivot|`, on the owned, borrowed and typed solve
  surfaces alike. Ties go to the first maximum. The `blas` feature of
  `tenferro-linalg` now also builds faer for this kernel. ([#2320](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2320), [#2328](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2328))
- Default (non-annealing) einsum contraction paths are deterministic across
  processes. Where earlier releases broke ties randomly, the chosen path may
  differ from a previous run. ([#2014](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2014))
- CPU floating and complex `reduce_prod` may reassociate, as `torch.prod` does.
  Rounding and range behavior depend on layout and thread count, and a partial
  product can overflow where the source-order product would not. ([#2179](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2179))
- CUDA `solve` no longer scans for singularity or reads the LU status back to
  the host. An exactly singular input returns provider-defined values, as in
  PyTorch; `lu_factor` and `lu` keep their `Singular` error. ([#2204](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2204))

## Features

- New `erf` primitive and composite operations on the eager, traced and
  concrete surfaces, each defined once for every backend: `sigmoid`, `silu`,
  `softplus`, `gelu`, `gelu_tanh`, `reduce_mean`, `softmax`, `log_softmax`,
  `masked_softmax`, `masked_log_softmax`, `layer_norm`, `rms_norm` and
  `take_along_axis`. ([#2017](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2017), [#2022](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2022))
- The erased `Tensor` gains `from_vec_row_major`, which reorders row-major data into column-major
  storage once. ([#2014](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2014))
- `[usize; N]` indexing on `ColMajorView`, `ColMajorViewMut` and
  `TypedTensor<T, Rank<N>>`, and host column-major views on tensors whose
  scalar is not a tenferro scalar. ([#2271](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2271))
- Concrete tensors gain read hooks for `scatter`, `slice`, `dynamic_slice`,
  `dynamic_update_slice`, `pad`, `concatenate`, `reverse`, `tril`, `triu`,
  `extract_diagonal` and `embed_diagonal` that consume views without staging
  copies. ([#2221](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2221))
- CUDA serves `dynamic_update_slice`. The CUDA indexing and structural read
  entries (including `tril`/`triu`) read strided, offset and negative-stride
  views in place without a staging copy, and copies, elementwise ops,
  `dot_general` and scaling accept a view as the destination. ([#2305](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2305), [#2311](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2311))
- A CPU batch policy (`CpuBatchPolicy`, `CpuBatchStrategy`,
  `CpuBatchThresholds`) chooses between fanning a batch out over threads and
  parallelizing inside each item. Set it with `CpuEngine::with_batch_policy` or
  the scoped `tenferro_cpu::with_batch_policy`. ([#1944](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1944), [#2187](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2187))
- `TENFERRO_CUDA_ARTIFACT_CACHE` names a directory that keeps compiled CUDA
  kernel images across processes. ([#2291](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2291))
- `Runtime::warm_up` runs a prepared program once so its kernels and plans are
  built before timed work. ([#2212](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2212))
- `tenferro_cpu::inject` gains `?geqp3`, `?ormqr`/`?unmqr` and `?syevd` slots
  for the column-pivoted QR, Householder application and real `eigh` routes
  of the `blas` build. ([#2323](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2323))

## Performance

- Caller-owned engines remove the session entry from every operation. At one
  thread, per-operation overhead fell by 15 to 40 percent (lazy `dot_general`
  from 4.69 to 3.97 us; `neg`, `add`, `reduce_sum` and `slice` 27 to 40
  percent faster). ([#2209](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2209))
- Two-operand einsums that reduce to one `dot_general` skip the contraction
  tree, with bit-identical results. A 16x16 `ij,jk->ik` went from 12.9 to
  4.5 us through the string API and from 4.9 to 2.9 us through a prepared plan.
  Cases that fall back (for example an outer product or a transposed output)
  pay about 1 to 2 us for the check. ([#2325](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2325))
- Prepared CPU programs pay less per command. A 25-command `grad_sum_qr_vjp`
  at 2x2 went from 71.4 to about 50 us and a 200-command elementwise program
  from 546 to about 285 us ([#2222](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2222)). Folding metadata-only views into their
  consumers then took the 2x2 case from 47.8 to 40.5 us and the one-command
  fixed cost from 4.4 to 3.4 us ([#2238](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2238)).
- A repeated eager f64 64x64 `matmul` reuses its contraction plan: 84 to 0
  heap allocations per call, and 22.4 to 16.5 us. A slot miss reuses the slot's
  plan storage. ([#2162](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2162), [#2317](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2317))
- The faer linear algebra lane uses pooled workspaces: QR, SVD and packed LU at
  one thread went from 12 to 14 allocations per call to 3, and tall Householder
  QR from 73 to 1. ([#2188](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2188))
- CPU `exp`, `log`, `sin`, `cos`, `tanh`, `expm1` and `log1p` on f32 and f64 run
  through SIMD kernels inside the parallel leaf. At 2^22 elements on four
  workers, `exp` went from 3.77 to 3.28 ns per element and `tanh` from 7.16 to
  5.80. ([#2090](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2090), [#2094](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2094), [#2097](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2097))
- Activations and softmax have fused SIMD CPU kernels. On 1024x64 f32 at one
  thread, `sigmoid` takes 44 us and `gelu` 65 us (PyTorch: 49 and 61 us), and a
  length-64 softmax 32 us. ([#2069](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2069), [#2231](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2231), [#2235](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2235))
- `rfft` and `irfft` run half-length real transforms; on a 524289-point input
  `rfft` takes 8.1 ms against 4.3 ms for MKL. ([#2232](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2232))
- Pooled CPU outputs return to the buffer pool on every operation family. At
  and above 32 MiB this removes the page faults of a fresh output on each call
  (a 2048x2048 matmul went from 58,535 to 25,767 minor faults over five calls).
  ([#2098](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2098), [#2100](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2100), [#2103](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2103))
- Tensors cache their compact layout, so building a view allocates nothing, and
  small-rank shapes and strides stay inline. ([#2149](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2149), [#2153](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2153), [#2162](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2162))
- On CUDA, the kernel-catalogue engine is faster than the CubeCL engine it
  replaces on every measured case at one thread (matmul 4.9 percent, `add` 33.7
  percent, reductions 13 to 67 percent) with bit-identical results. Standard
  batched matmul uses one strided-batched cuBLAS call instead of cuTENSOR.
  ([#2193](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2193), [#2291](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2291))

## Fixes

- `det` and `slogdet` reject non-square input with `RankMismatch` or
  `ShapeMismatch` on the owned, read, eager and traced paths; a traced
  rectangular binding fails at compile time. The empty fast paths of `solve`,
  `inv` and `full_piv_lu_solve` no longer return a value for a rectangular
  input. A `0x0` determinant is still 1.
  ([#2329](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2329))
- `TracedTensor::dynamic_slice` validates its window at graph build time.
  Slice, `dynamic_slice` and `gather` build-time checks match the backends.
  ([#2157](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2157), [#2167](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2167))
- `inv` and `pinv` work on CUDA-resident input, complex `pinv` scales in the
  operand's dtype, and `eig` returns unit 2-norm eigenvectors. ([#2157](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2157))
- The VJP of `embed_diag` with `axis_b < axis_a` no longer applies a spurious
  transpose. ([#2157](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2157))
- `TracedTensor::concatenate` of two distinct inputs compiles without input
  specs. ([#2157](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2157))
- AD of `maximum`, `minimum` and `clamp` no longer turns a non-finite
  cotangent into `NaN` through its mask seeds, and an inactive `wrt` returns a
  typed validation error instead of `Internal`. ([#1961](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1961))
- The default `to_contiguous_read` gathers strided host views instead of
  rejecting them. ([#1961](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1961))
- An explicit `SvdDriver::Xgesvdp` on CUDA checks cuSOLVER's error bound per
  batch member and returns a typed error instead of impossible singular values
  on rank-deficient input. `SvdDriver::Auto` keeps the accuracy-preserving
  drivers. ([#2184](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2184))
- CUDA complex division is scale-robust, including a real scalar divided by a
  complex value, so extreme or non-finite divisors no longer give `0` or `NaN`
  where the quotient is representable. ([#1970](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1970), [#1997](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1997), [#1999](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/1999))
- A consuming in-place FFT accepts a compact offset slice of a host allocation
  and transforms only that slice. ([#2173](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2173))

## Documentation

- The API migration guide, guides, tutorial code and shipped agent skills are
  rewritten for caller-owned engines and `threadteam` pools. ([#2209](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2209), [#2276](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2276),
  [#2289](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2289))
- The cost of a buffer-pool retention limit below the output size is
  documented next to `CpuEngine::set_buffer_pool_limit_bytes`. ([#2292](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2292), [#2294](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2294))
- The README links the tensor4all stack overview. ([#2265](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2265))

## Known limitations

- CUDA does not yet support `eig`, `full_piv_lu` or `full_piv_lu_solve`
  (they return `Unsupported`).
- The CUDA raw session exposes the stream, allocations, copies and vendor
  handles, but no kernel compile-and-launch surface. Downstream `#[cube]`
  kernels, previously launched through the CubeCL session, have no replacement
  in this release. ([#2291](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2291))
- ROCm/HIP remains a stub.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/compare/v0.7.1...v0.8.0
